Before installing or using it: (1) ask the publisher for the implementation or a homepage/repo so you can review code; (2) test with non-sensitive/sample CSVs only; (3) do not provide any credentials or proprietary data until you confirm where the analysis runs and who has access; (4) note the manifest version (skill.json lists 1.0.0) differs from the registry version (1.0.35) — ask the author to clarify. If you need higher assurance, request the skill's code or prefer a skill backed by a public repository or known vendor.
